newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel steady but quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel steady but quiet.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was steady on Tuesday with prices talked in the mid $140s fob NWE.
Activity was quiet although U.S. interest was still shown, although nothing was heard done. The sector was seen balanced - tightly supplied matched against little serious enquiry.
High sulphur straight was seen well supplied with M-100 with prices talked around $121-122 cif NWE. Most dealers said prices would rise as product became scarcer towards November.
The quality of E-4 kept premiums alive with fixed prices talked as high as $132-134. An M-40 sold at $121 cif Antwerp.
